assets.visual_notes: Close seated-car crop. Very large rounded paired pectoral masses, strong central cleft, visible chest-hair texture, arm crossing the lower torso. Establishes the primary chest shape and projection target.

Same seated-car setup, face, beard, arm placement, and crop. The chest reads marginally fuller and more rounded than the base, especially through the upper and lateral contour; treat this as a subtle visual difference, not a measured growth stage.

Same composition and subject design. The paired pec masses appear more spherical and forward-projecting, with a pronounced medial cleft and lower contour; the viewer-right pec is especially full. Camera perspective and close crop exaggerate apparent depth.
Full-body scale against a domestic doorway. Useful for chest-to-shoulder breadth, limb mass, overall silhouette, and environmental scale; not assumed to be the same character as the car sequence.
Full-body interior composition. Useful for figure-to-room ratio and overall proportions; keep as comparative context rather than merging its character identity into the car sequence.
Three-quarter/full-body body-surface and garment reference. Useful for pectoral-to-deltoid transition, upper-body mass, and clothing fit; not assumed to depict the car subject.

Low-resolution seated-car image with a similar crop and subject presentation. Its relationship to the generated car sequence is not established by the canonical manifest; preserve as a separate source candidate and do not infer identity or generation lineage.
